sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Twisted Rope Heart Gold Stainless Steel Hoop Earrings
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Romantic and bold — our Twisted Rope Heart Hoop Earrings feature a thick twisted rope-style gold hoop with a raised heart charm at the bottom centre. The combination of texture and sentiment makes this a standout piece that is both trendy and meaningful.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Twisted rope texture + raised heart charm at base
- Oval hoop silhouette — modern and flattering
Pairs with: Casual western, indo-western, date night outfits.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
